The '''2023 Road to Worlds''' was played on [[GEMP]] (play.starwarsccg.org), 19 July – 9 August 2023, on the road to the 28th Star Wars CCG [[2023 World Championship]]. [[Justin Desai]] finished first. Jnapolit31 posted the final standings on 24 August 2023 and thanked EBT for reconstructing them.<ref name="rtw23">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1412266#p1412266 FINAL STANDINGS: Road to Worlds 2023], Jnapolit31, Players Committee forum (24 August 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125022156/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1412266.html Internet Archive].</ref>
